newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-CZECHS CHANGE DOUBLES TEAM TO KORDA, DAMM.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CZECHS CHANGE DOUBLES TEAM TO KORDA, DAMM.

text.p: Captain Vladislav Savrda called upon Petr Korda to play the doubles portion of the Czech Republic's Davis Cup World Group first round tie with Martin Damm against India on Saturday.
Savrda had originally named Damm and Pavel Vizner to face the Indian pair of Leander Paes and Mahesh Bhupathi.
In the quarter and semifinals of the tournament last year, Savrda turned to Korda to help keep his country in the tournament when it was on the brink of elimination.
India and the Czech Republic split their opening singles matches on Friday.
